methodology.detail: METHODOLOGY & REGULATORY BASIS
Sources: Reg. (EU) 2023/1805 (FuelEU Maritime) & Reg. (EU) 2015/757 (EU MRV, CO₂ monitoring). EU ETS via Dir. 2003/87/EC.
1 · Geographic scope & leg percentages
Each row is classified from the EU/EEA flag of its From/To ports (Port_DB tab):
•  Port stay at an EU/EEA port → 100% of emissions/energy in scope.
•  Voyage between two EU/EEA ports → 100% in scope.
•  Voyage where exactly one port is EU/EEA (to/from a non-EU port) → 50% in scope.
•  Voyage to/from an Outermost Region port → 50% in scope (and flagged for the Member-State derogation, see tab "Derogations").
•  Voyage with no EU/EEA port → 0% (out of scope).
In-scope set = EU-27 + Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein (EEA) + French outermost territories (GP, MQ, GF, RE, MF, YT).
Caveat: FuelEU does not yet treat NO/IS/LI as EEA member ports — calls there are currently non-member calls for FuelEU only. Verify per latest guidance.
2 · Energy per fuel
Energy (MJ) = Σ fuel Mi(g)×LCVi(MJ/g) + Σ OPS electricity Ek. LCV & factors from Annex II (Fuel_Reference).
Total row energy = Fossil 1 + Fossil 2 + Biofuel 1.   In-scope energy = Total × Leg %.
3 · EU ETS emissions & allowances

EU ETS / MRV: CO₂ = fuel × emission factor (MRV Annex I.A). From 2026 also CH₄ & N₂O as CO₂eq, using IPCC AR5 GWP (CH₄=28, N₂O=265) per revised MRV Reg (EU) 2023/957 — distinct from FuelEU which uses AR4 (25/298).
EU ETS gas scope is year-dependent: CO₂ only for 2024–2025; CO₂ + CH₄ + N₂O (as CO₂eq) from 1 Jan 2026 (Dir. (EU) 2023/959). Phase-in of allowances: 40% (2024), 70% (2025), 100% (2026+).
ETS CO₂-only split via fossil Cf_CO₂. Certified-biofuel biogenic CO₂ is zero-rated, but its CH₄ & N₂O are included in ETS CO₂eq from 2026.
RED-certified biofuel: biogenic CO₂ is zero-rated under ETS (toggle on Parameters tab; default Yes).
EUAs required (t) = in-scope CO₂eq × phase-in % (40% 2024 · 70% 2025 · 100% from 2026).
Indicative cost = EUAs × EUA price (Parameters tab).
4 · FuelEU GHG intensity — Annex I Eq.(1)&(2)
GHGIE = f_wind × [ Σ(energyᵢ×WtTᵢ) + Σ(massᵢ×TtWᵢ) ] ÷ [ Σ(energyᵢ×RWDᵢ)+ΣEk ].  energy=Mass×LCV; WtT per-MJ ×energy, TtW per-gFuel ×mass.
TtW CO₂eq,i (gCO₂eq/gFuel) = (1−Cslip/100)(Cf_CO₂+Cf_CH₄·GWP_CH₄+Cf_N₂O·GWP_N₂O)+(Cslip/100)·GWP_CH₄.  NOT divided by LCV (Annex I Eq.1: TtW term is mass-based).
Two GWP sets are kept separate: FuelEU AR4 (CH₄25/N₂O298, RED II) for GHG-intensity; EU ETS/MRV AR5 (CH₄28/N₂O265) for ETS CO₂eq. Both editable on Parameters.
f_wind reward (Annex I): 0.99 (Pwind/Pprop 0.05), 0.97 (0.10), 0.95 (≥0.15); 1.00 if no wind assist.
RFNBO reward RWD=2 (2025–2033) in GHGIE denominator only (Art. 5). OPS electricity: numerator term=0 (zero-rated), counts in denominator; RWD not applied (Art. 5(10)).
5 · Compliance balance (Annex IV.A) & penalty (Annex IV.B, Art. 23)
Compliance balance (t CO₂eq) = (GHGIEtarget − GHGIEactual) × [Σ(Mi·LCVi)+ΣEk] ÷ 1,000,000.  Reward factor NOT applied (Annex IV.A). + surplus / − deficit.
If deficit → penalty (EUR) = |CB(t)|×1,000,000 ÷ (GHGIEactual × 41,000) × 2,400 (Annex IV.B).
Repeat deficit: × (1 + (n−1)/10) for n consecutive deficit periods (Art. 23(2)). Banking/borrowing & pooling per Arts. 20–21 (not modelled).
6 · Data sources
Fuel factors: Reg. (EU) 2023/1805 Annex II (default WtT, Cf_CO₂/CH₄/N₂O, Cslip, LCV). Fossil values fixed; biofuel/RFNBO WtW certified per PoS (RED II).
Outermost-region ports: Outermost_Most_Regions_Port_codes.csv.

6 · EU MRV (Reg. 2015/757): per-voyage monitoring of fuel, CO₂, distance, time at sea, cargo, transport work (=distance×cargo, Annex II.A). Efficiency indicators (Annex II.B): CO₂/distance, CO₂/transport-work — shown on dashboard ⑤.
Fuel CO₂ emission factors (Cf_CO₂) are common to MRV (Reg. 601/2012/IPCC) and FuelEU Annex II; fossil Cf_CO₂ may not be diverged from (Art. 10(4)/(5)).

formulaGuide.Column 3: VLOOKUP of UN/LOCODE in Port_DB → name, EU/EEA flag, OMR & small-island flag.
Port stay→100% if EU; Voyage→100% intra-EU, 50% if one non-EU or OMR, 0% if no EU port.
Σ fuel: Cons(MT)×1,000,000×LCV.  In-scope = ×Leg%.  OPS electricity added to FuelEU energy.
Tank-to-Wake: Σ(mass×TtW gCO₂eq/gFuel)/10⁶ ×Leg%. CO₂=fuel×Cf (MRV Annex I.A). Biogenic CO₂ zero-rated.
f_wind × [Σ(energy×WtT) + Σ(mass×TtW)] ÷ Σ(energy×RWD). TtW mass-based gCO₂eq/gFuel (no ×LCV); WtT per-MJ. GWP 1/25/298 (AR4).
(Target − Attained) × Σ(M·LCV+electricity) ÷ 1,000,000 → tonnes CO₂eq. Reward factor EXCLUDED (Annex IV.A). +surplus/−deficit.
Transport work = distance×cargo (Annex II.A). CO₂/distance & CO₂/transport-work (Annex II.B) on dashboard ⑤.
